SECTION: DOTC01 §1 — executable object map. Every object this mission needs, and where it lives.

Y_BIRTH_LAW.exact: p = min(1, kY * nX * nY) per cell; cand = min(n[SY], free); births ~ Binomial(cand, p)
Y_BIRTH_LAW.consequence: a Y birth occurs ONLY at a cell that already holds a Y, so a newborn Y is always co-located with a parent constituent and therefore always inside the same centre component
Y_BIRTH_LAW.recoverable: EXACT, event-aligned, from PQEC01 raw `ybirth` = (step, y, x, n_born)

Y_DEATH_LAW.exact: d ~ Binomial(n[Y], muY) per cell, per-molecule Bernoulli
Y_DEATH_LAW.recoverable: EXACT, event-aligned, from PQEC01 raw `ydeath` = (step, y, x, n_died)

Y_DIFFUSION.where: ORR01/code/kinetics.py _diffuse, called for Y in the frozen step order
Y_DIFFUSION.recoverable: EXACT from PQEC01 raw `yhop` = (step, sub, shift, ax, y_from, x_from, n_accepted)

CENTRE_CLASSIFIER.exact: toroidal single-linkage over Y-occupied cells with adjacency distance <= CORE_R
CENTRE_CLASSIFIER.recoverable: EXACT per step from PQEC01 raw `ycells` (step,y,x,...) which lists every Y-occupied cell

LOCAL_X_SOURCE_LAW.exact: p = min(1, kX * nX * nY); births ~ Binomial(min(n[SX],free), p) — X is born ONLY at Y-occupied cells
LOCAL_X_SOURCE_LAW.recoverable: world totals per step from PQEC01 raw `xevent` = (step, n_X_born, n_X_died); per-cell X births are NOT stored by PQEC01 and are recoverable only by replay

PERSISTENT_CENTRE_TRACKER.status: DOES NOT EXIST AS A STORED OBJECT
PERSISTENT_CENTRE_TRACKER.consequence: centre identity across steps must be RECONSTRUCTED from `ycells` by spatial matching; no stored object asserts it and none is assumed

Y_BIRTH_DEATH_LEDGERS.status: PRESENT AND EXACT in PQEC01 raw
Y_BIRTH_DEATH_LEDGERS.recorded_how: the Y-plane difference across _react() and across _decay() respectively, so they are exact and event-aligned, not inferred

X_BIRTH_LEDGER.status: WORLD-TOTAL ONLY in PQEC01 (`xevent`); per-cell X birth positions are not stored

FMRT01_THREE_ARM_FORK.note: FMRT01 archives store per-arm world totals every 25 steps and a tracker snapshot at t_m only; they contain NO Y birth/death ledger, so the organiser question cannot be answered from FMRT01 raw alone

THE_DATA_SOURCE_FOR_THIS_MISSION.primary: /home/claude/PQEC01/raw — 128 archives, 958 MB, with exact Y ledgers
THE_DATA_SOURCE_FOR_THIS_MISSION.why_no_replay_is_needed: PQEC01 recorded the exact event-aligned Y ledgers and the per-step local environment at every Y-occupied cell. Everything DOTC01 needs about the organiser process is in those bytes. No world is constructed and no trajectory is run.
